text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's the final delivery! And<n>my time's a
new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now I've just got to call my manager<n>and ask for
next week off...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should invite Trainer, too.

Bright and early one morning, Ines<n>Fujin comes
running into my office<n>completely out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello-lo, Trainer! I've got an invitation<n>for you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Are you free this weekend? Let's go<n>to Kyoto
together!

Ines Fujin goes on to explain her<n>plan to me. It
turns out her real<n>objective is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! The spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I heard Ryan and McQueen are<n>running, so this is
our chance to<n>check out their current condition!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I'm a front runner, right?<n>That means I
hardly get any<n>opportunities to get a good look at
those two closing in from behind.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And the best place to scope them out<n>while they're
doing that is gonna be<n>the stands, right? Plus...
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryan! Show the world just<n>how
incredible the Mejiro family is!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow. All they did was come out of<n>the tunnel, and
the audience is going<n>wild...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan and McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! You're both truly wonderful! I<n>do hope
you'll do your very best to<n>claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can see the sparkle in their fans'<n>eyes from here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So Ryan and McQueen get showered<n>with all this
attention every time they<n>race...

Moments later, the starting gates<n>burst open and
the spring Tenno Sho<n>begins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is in the lead! It's<n>Mejiro
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Does Mejiro Ryan have what it takes<n>to nab
second place?! McQueen is<n>still in the lead! Aaand
just like that,<n>she crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...She's strong.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
That's McQueen for you! She took all<n>that pressure
in stride and realized<n>the Mejiro family's
ambitions!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
But I can't believe Ryan came fourth...<n>She didn't
even break the top three...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this means McQueen's<n>going to be the
one to guide the<n>Mejiro family forward...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I have something to say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but next time,<n>the glory's
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the<n>Mejiro family!
And at the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will
show you<n>that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's right! I'll always be<n>rooting for you,
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know if I could've said<n>something like that
after finishing in<n>fourth...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah, there's no way. I wouldn't<n>be able to hide
my disappointment.<n>That's the difference between
Ryan<n>and me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the words of someone<n>who's lived
shouldering<n>expectations.
choice_data_list: Did you learn anything about your opponents?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, totally! This trip to Kyoto was<n>really worth it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now I know exactly what I'll be up<n>against in the
Takarazuka Kinen!

Ines Fujin sears the image of her
friends-slash-rivals into her mind.
